propositions: Five new scheduled-only, non-gating sweep jobs must be added to test.yml to cover Python 3.14 stable, pre-release interpreters (3.15, 3.14t), Windows, full macOS suite, declared dependency lower bounds, and external doc links without impacting Gerrit Verified gate latency.

The sweep-interpreters job for Python 3.14 must use the committed uv.lock file (uv sync --locked) to test interpreter compatibility against the exact locked dependency set, while pre-release cells re-resolve and remain non-blocking via continue-on-error.
The sweep-lower-bounds job must validate that declared dependency floors resolve and work on Python 3.11 using uv pip install --resolution lowest-direct on the core+dev+agents extras subset.
The sweep-doc-links job must use lychee-action pinned to v2.9.0 commit SHA to check external links in README.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, and docs/**/*.md with fail: false.
The 3.14-stable and sweep-lower-bounds jobs must NOT set REBAR_REQUIRE_EXTRAS to avoid hard failures from extra_guard.py when fewer extras are installed than the gate.

All five sweep jobs must be added to EXCLUDED_JOBS in check_verify_gate_parity.py and all pytest sweep lanes must include --timeout=600 --timeout-method=thread to pass existing CI parity contract tests.
